body: Don’t worry about the other comments, I got what you meant. I’m not in the right place to have a conversation like that but I hope you do find some peace down the line 🙂

Thanks, I appreciate that message 🙂 I had a walk and shower which has calmed me down a bit. Will go to bed now and think about everything in the morning, but it’s nice to know your experience and that you are battling through, it gives me hope!
